field.label: Product Index Suffix
field.comment: Suffix for the FastMagento product index (<engine prefix>_<suffix>). Default "products".

field.label: Category Index Suffix
field.comment: Suffix for the FastMagento category index. Default "categories".

group.label: Instant Search & Relevance
group.comment: Controls what a query matches and in what order. A query flows: clean (stop words) → expand (synonyms) → match (weighted fields, with the Operator & Typo rules) → boost (phrase / all-terms / in-stock) → sort (custom ranking). Full breakdown with worked examples in the extension's docs/SETTINGS.md. Re-run indexer:reindex catalogsearch_fulltext after changing searchable attributes or the AI keyword layer.

field.label: Searchable Attributes & Weights
field.comment: Attributes searched, ranked by weight (higher = stronger). One place to control what Magento otherwise hides in each attribute's Search Weight. Leave empty to use the built-in defaults (name, sku, description).

field.label: Typo Tolerance
field.comment: Fuzzy matching so misspellings still find results (like Algolia typo tolerance).

field.label: Boost In-Stock Products
field.comment: Rank in-stock products above out-of-stock ones (a custom-ranking tie-breaker).

field.label: Custom Ranking Attribute
field.comment: Optional numeric attribute used as a secondary ranking signal after text relevance (e.g. bestseller position, rating). Blank = relevance only.

field.label: Custom Ranking Direction
field.comment: Only applies when a Custom Ranking Attribute is set above. Highest first for bestseller rank / rating / popularity; Lowest first for price-low or "position" fields. Products missing the attribute always sort last (never dropped).

field.label: Synonyms / Thesaurus
field.comment: One equivalence group per line, comma-separated (e.g. bra, brassiere, bralette). A search for any term also matches the others. Pre-populated with common defaults; edit freely.

field.label: Stop Words
field.comment: Comma- or space-separated words ignored in queries (e.g. the, a, for, with). Pre-populated with common English stop words.

field.label: Facet Attributes
field.comment: Comma-separated attribute codes to build search facets from (e.g. part_type,compatible_platforms). Must be filterable in the native search index. Category is always included.

field.label: Multi-Term Operator
field.comment: How multiple words combine. Any = OR (a match on one word is enough — broadest). Most = 75% of words must match. All = AND (every word must match — most precise). Use All/Most to stop e.g. "Frontend UTV" returning frontend-only products.

field.label: Exact / Phrase Match Boost
field.comment: How strongly to rank products where the query appears as a contiguous phrase (in name/keywords) above scattered-word hits. Higher = exact matches rank harder. 0 disables. Default 4.

field.label: AI Search Keywords
field.comment: Search the AI-generated per-product keyword layer (fm_search_keywords). Populate it off the request path with bin/magento fastmagento:search-keywords:generate, then reindex catalogsearch_fulltext. Lets a "UTV" product surface for "side-by-side / SxS" even when its copy never says it.

field.label: AI Keyword Weight
field.comment: Search weight for the AI keyword field, relative to other attributes (name defaults to 5). Default 8 = keyword hits rank strongly. Only used when AI Search Keywords is enabled.

field.label: AI Keyword Source Attributes
field.comment: Comma-separated attribute codes whose labels give the AI product context when generating keywords (e.g. part_type,make,model). Blank = reuse the Facet Attributes above.

group.label: AI Assistant (Claude)
group.comment: Connect a Claude API key to auto-generate a search thesaurus from your own catalogue. Get a key at console.anthropic.com.

field.label: Claude API Key
field.comment: Stored encrypted. Used only for the generator below; leave blank to disable AI features.

field.label: Model
field.comment: Claude model id. Default claude-opus-4-8.

field.label: Max Catalogue Terms
field.comment: Upper bound on attribute values + category names sent to the model (keeps large catalogues bounded). Default 1200.

field.label: Generate Thesaurus
field.comment: Reads your attribute values + categories and builds shopper-facing synonym groups, merged into Search > Synonyms above. Save the API Key first. Review and Save the Synonyms field afterward.

field.label: Enable Fast Checkout
field.comment: On by default. Serves cart/checkout line products (and configurable variants) from the OpenSearch index instead of the native ~217-query product collection, and skips the redundant per-load stock revalidation. This is what removes the multi-second cost of configurable products at checkout. Order placement still re-checks salable quantity by SKU, so it cannot oversell; missing/partial index products fall back to the native path automatically. Run a full reindex and place a test order after go-live to confirm totals; set to No to fall back to the fully native cart. Equivalent to enabling both advanced toggles below.

field.label: Advanced: Serve Quote Items from OpenSearch
field.comment: Advanced / granular control — only shown while "Enable Fast Checkout" is No, which already turns this on. Hydrate cart/checkout line products from the OpenSearch index instead of the native ~217-query product collection. Hard native fallback for any product missing/partial in the index, custom-option carts, and bundle/grouped products, so it never half-serves a cart. Live stock is still loaded natively (no overselling).

field.label: Advanced: Optimistic Stock (skip redundant pre-placement checks)
field.comment: Advanced / granular control — only shown while "Enable Fast Checkout" is No, which already turns this on. Serve cart/checkout stock from the live-indexed OpenSearch data and skip the redundant per-load MySQL stock preload. Order placement still re-checks salable quantity by SKU (MSI reservations) and rejects a truly out-of-stock order, so this cannot oversell. Trade-off: if the index is briefly stale, a shopper may reach the final placement step before being told an item is unavailable. Validate with a real order first.

field.label: Advanced: Fast Stock Sync (patch index instead of full reproject)
field.comment: Advanced / granular control — only shown while "Enable Fast Checkout" is No, which already turns this on. When an order, refund or inventory save changes stock, patch only the stock fields of the affected OpenSearch documents (in-stock flag, quantity, and composite child stock) instead of reprojecting the whole product from the database. Much cheaper for large configurables. Runs after the response is sent, so it never adds shopper latency. Automatically falls back to a full reprojection for any product not fully present in the index, so the index can't be left stale.

field.label: Configurable Line-Item Name
field.comment: Which name to show for a configurable product on the cart, mini-cart and checkout: the Configurable (parent) name — Magento default, e.g. "Keira Banded Underwire Bra" with Color/Size beneath — or the specific Simple (variant) name. Display only; does not affect price or the placed order line data.

group.label: Extension Efficiency Monitor
group.comment: Profiles how much database work each third-party extension adds to the hot paths (indexing, product pages, category grids, search). View the report under FastMagento > Extension Efficiency. You can run a scan on demand from that page, on a schedule below, or with bin/magento fastmagento:efficiency:scan.

field.label: Run Scan on a Schedule
field.comment: Off by default. When on, a scan runs automatically on the schedule below and refreshes the monitor.

field.label: Schedule (cron expression)
field.comment: Standard cron expression. Default "0 3 * * 0" = every Sunday at 3:00 AM. Avoid overlapping a full reindex.

field.label: Sample Size
field.comment: Products/rows profiled per scenario (default 50). Higher = steadier averages, slower scan.
